info.name: Tyk Dashboard Admin Additional Permissions UserGroup API
info.description:
For Tyk On-Premises installations only, the Dashboard Admin API has two endpoints and is used to set up and provision a Tyk Dashboard instance without the command line.

In order to use the Dashboard Admin API, you'll need to get the `admin_secret` value from your Tyk Dashboard configurations.

The secret you set should then be sent along as a header with each Dashboard Admin API Request in order for it to be successful:

```
admin-auth: <your-secret>
```

variable.description: (Required) ID of the group you want to update.

request.description: Update the details of a user group. You must have either admin or user groups permission to be able to modify user groups. Note you cannot update the ResetPassword permission with this endpoint. For that you need to use Admin API. When updating a user group you also need to specify at least one permission in the user_permissions field.
